bottom_line: In DAPA-HF, dapagliflozin vs placebo reduced the primary composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.85).
implications: These data show that, over a median of 18.2 months, dapagliflozin compared with placebo was associated with a lower incidence of the primary composite outcome (16.3% vs. 21.2%; hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.85; P<0.001) and lower all-cause mortality (11.6% vs. 13.9%; hazard ratio, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.97), while selected adverse events of interest such as volume depletion (7.5% vs. 6.8%) and renal adverse events (6.5% vs. 7.2%) were reported at similar frequencies; the trial also reports results were similar in patients with and without diabetes.

major_points.text: Phase 3 placebo-controlled randomized trial in symptomatic HFrEF (LVEF ≤40%) comparing dapagliflozin 10 mg daily vs placebo on top of recommended therapy.
major_points.quote: In this phase 3, placebo-controlled trial, we randomly assigned 4744 patients with New York Heart Association class II, III, or IV heart failure and an ejection fraction of 40% or less to receive either dapagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily) or placebo

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was composite of worsening heart failure (hospitalization or urgent visit requiring IV therapy) or cardiovascular death.
major_points.quote: The primary outcome was a composite of worsening heart failure (hospitalization or an urgent visit resulting in intravenous therapy for heart failure) or cardiovascular death.

major_points.text: Primary outcome occurred less often with dapagliflozin than placebo, with HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.65 to 0.85).
major_points.quote: the primary outcome occurred in 386 of 2373 patients (16.3%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 502 of 2371 patients (21.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.85;

major_points.text: All-cause death was lower with dapagliflozin than placebo (hazard ratio 0.83; 95% CI 0.71 to 0.97).
major_points.quote: 276 patients (11.6%) and 329 patients (13.9%), respectively, died from any cause (hazard ratio, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.71 to 0.97).

major_points.text: Adverse events of interest included volume depletion and renal adverse events; serious renal adverse events were less frequent with dapagliflozin than placebo.
major_points.quote: Serious renal adverse events occurred in 38 patients (1.6%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 65 patients (2.7%) in the placebo group (P = 0.009).

major_points.text: The effect on the primary outcome was generally consistent in patients with and without type 2 diabetes.
major_points.quote: Findings in patients with diabetes were similar to those in patients without diabetes.

absolute_effects.text: Number needed to treat to prevent one primary event was 21 (95% CI, 15 to 38).
absolute_effects.quote: the number of patients who would need to have been treated with dapagliflozin to prevent one primary event was 21 (95% CI, 15 to 38).

inclusion_criteria.quote: Eligibility requirements included an age of at least 18 years

inclusion_criteria.text: Left ventricular ejection fraction of 40% or less.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Eligibility requirements included an age of at least 18 years, an ejection fraction of 40% or less

inclusion_criteria.text: NYHA class II, III, or IV symptoms.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Eligibility requirements included an age of at least 18 years, an ejection fraction of 40% or less, and New York Heart Association (NYHA) class II, III, or IV symptoms.

inclusion_criteria.text: NT-proBNP at least 600 pg/ml, or ≥400 pg/ml if hospitalized for heart failure within previous 12 months.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Patients were required to have a plasma level of N-terminal pro–B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) of at least 600 pg per milliliter (or ≥400 pg per milliliter if they had been hospitalized for heart failure within the previous 12 months).

inclusion_criteria.text: If atrial fibrillation or flutter on baseline ECG, NT-proBNP at least 900 pg/ml.
inclusion_criteria.quote: Patients with atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter on baseline electrocardiography were required to have an NT-proBNP level of at least 900 pg per milliliter

exclusion_criteria.text: Recent treatment with or unacceptable side effects associated with an SGLT2 inhibitor.
exclusion_criteria.quote: Exclusion criteria included recent treatment with or unacceptable side effects associated with an SGLT2 inhibitor
Exclusion criteria included recent treatment with or unacceptable side effects associated with an SGLT2 inhibitor, type 1 diabetes mellitus

analysis_methods.text: Primary and secondary outcomes analyzed in all randomized patients using intention-to-treat.
analysis_methods.quote: We included data from all the patients who had undergone randomization in the analyses of the primary and secondary outcomes, according to the intention-to-treat principle.

analysis_methods.text: Type I error controlled at two-sided alpha 0.0499 with one interim efficacy analysis.
analysis_methods.quote: The type I error was controlled at a two-sided alpha level of 0.0499 for multiple comparisons across primary and secondary outcomes, with one interim efficacy analysis taken into account.

analysis_methods.text: Time-to-event outcomes evaluated with Kaplan–Meier estimates and Cox proportional-hazards models stratified by diabetes status.
analysis_methods.quote: Time-to-event data were evaluated with the use of Kaplan–Meier estimates and Cox proportional-hazards models, stratified according to diabetes status

analysis_methods.text: Total (including recurrent) events analyzed using a semiparametric proportional-rates model.
analysis_methods.quote: and used a semiparametric proportional-rates model to calculate total (including recurrent) events.

analysis_methods.text: Estimated enrollment of approximately 4500 patients based on expected placebo annual event incidence and follow-up.
analysis_methods.quote: we estimated that the enrollment of approximately 4500 patients would provide the required number of primary events, based on an anticipated recruitment period of 18 months and an average follow-up period of approximately 24 months.
